blocks.text: Mato Grosso brings together three great ecosystems within easy reach of Cuiabá: the southern edge of the Amazon, the Cerrado and the Pantanal. The Cerrado, the original vegetation of Brazil’s heartland, is considered the richest savanna in the world for its plant diversity, and many of Brazil’s great rivers have their sources here, with areas of spectacular beauty such as Chapada dos Guimarães National Park, near the geodesic centre of South America. The Pantanal, one of the last great wildernesses and the largest tropical wetland on the planet, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and Biosphere Reserve and South America’s greatest wildlife sanctuary.
